summary: unarchive options: attributes, copy (deprecated for remote_src), creates guard under dest, decrypt vaulted sources, the required existing dest, exclude list, and extra_opts as an array.
questions: How do I skip extraction if it was already done?
Does unarchive create the destination directory?
How do I exclude some files from extraction?
How do I pass extra tar options to unarchive?

answer_card.title: unarchive parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `dest` (required): must already exist (not created)
- `creates`: path under dest; skip if exists
- `exclude`: entries to skip (exclusive with `include`)
- `extra_opts`: list, one element per arg, e.g. `[--transform, s/^xxx/yyy/]`
- `decrypt` (true): vault decryption
- `copy`: deprecated, use `remote_src`
